name: Example: Tutor Marketplace
description: Illustrative idea-stage profile. Parents find and book vetted tutors for their children, pay per session, and tutors upload certifications. An AI assistant drafts session summaries from tutor notes.
data_notes: Parent and tutor identity and contact details
Children's names, ages and learning needs
Payment records (card data held by the payment provider)
deployment_notes: Platforms named in the brief: Supabase and Stripe; hosting not chosen yet.
assumptions: Built from a two-sentence brief; every capability the brief does not mention is left unknown.
Children are data subjects even though parents hold the accounts.
